name: Knee Circle
steps: Stand with your feet and knees together, bend your knees slightly, and rest your palms lightly on your kneecaps or just above them.
Keep your heels grounded and guide both knees smoothly in a controlled circular motion in one direction.
Move comfortably through your ankle and knee range without forcing painful angles.
Reverse direction halfway through and continue circling smoothly for the target duration.
tips: Keep the circles gentle and controlled rather than pushing forcefully down on your kneecaps.
Keep your feet flat on the floor so your ankles and knees mobilize smoothly together.
